why: phase-417 stage 0 — visible only because the rclcpp adapter (then `rclcpp_compat.hpp`; deleted at stage 6 step A, each declaration moved to the header owning its concept) became a translation unit (issue 1020). The shim ships this TYPE as a name, so its members stop inheriting "we do not have this type" and become their own claim. Not a new gap: a gap INSIDE a type we ship is a different statement from one about a type we do not. `rclcpp_action::Server`'s member surface is the wait-set/`Waitable` protocol (`execute`, `is_ready`, `set_on_ready_callback`) plus `make_shared`; the executor owns readiness here and entities are arena-registered at creation (RFC-0002), so there is nothing for a caller to poll or construct.
